prompts.name: tripwright-main
prompts.title: Answer on the road from the user's trip
prompts.description: Use when a user message concerns a trip managed by Tripwright: a question on the road ("最晚几点出发去机场", "我饿了，想吃点东西", "我得赶紧走吗"), a status report ("I am alone today"), a replan, planning from scratch, a batch of new requirements, or "which of my preferences did you use". Returns two labelled parts in one reply: a short answer from the stored plan, then one after checking what the user will act on. Claude Code may send the second part when its background researcher reports: 核过 only for a Tripwright tool result, anything read on the web with its source. Sourced lookups, deep checks of a draft and splitting a large batch belong to tripwright-researcher, tripwright-verifier and tripwright-requirements; travel talk without Tripwright uses the host's normal tools.

prompts.name: tripwright-requirements
prompts.title: Split a batch of travel requirements into proposals
prompts.description: Use when a Tripwright user sends a large batch of interleaved requirements (several voice messages, a pasted list, a long planning brief) or a message whose parts are hard to separate. Returns proposed ledger records with their exact quotes, scope, strength, readings and declared relations, the conflicts with existing records, and the source questions for the user; it decides and commits nothing. Planning and answering stay with tripwright-main.

prompts.name: tripwright-researcher
prompts.title: Sourced check of one fact for a Tripwright answer
prompts.description: Use when an answer or plan depends on a fact the user will act on and the main agent does not hold it from a live source: whether a place is open now, the last departure tonight and the night fallback, whether an event is on, whether a building is open at night, a ticket rule, which app shows buses in a region. Returns each finding with its source, what it is valid for and the line of the answer it confirms or changes; says plainly when nothing was found. Planning and answering stay with tripwright-main; judging a whole draft is tripwright-verifier.

prompts.name: tripwright-verifier
prompts.title: Independent deep check of a Tripwright draft
prompts.description: Use after the main agent has answered and proposed a draft, to check that draft from independent input before it is shown as the checked plan. Returns a verdict (passed, conflict or incomplete), one line per check and a disposition for every required item; a stale job returns only “已过期，需重算”. Changing or committing the plan stays with tripwright-main; an open question of fact goes to tripwright-researcher.
